# Career Hub import

Both standalone brand HTML files and all ten variations contain My Systems & Resources.

- 160 skill records
- 14 MCP directory records
- 12 system blueprints and 12 system maps
- 133 resource records in 15 source categories
- 184 embedded source files; SHA-256 verified

Skills, MCPs, systems and resource board categories, descriptions, verdicts and remarks were retained. The import does not install skills or connect MCPs. Status fields are the source author's snapshot, not new live verification.

No CVs, career portfolio documents, publications, social posts or unrelated playbooks are embedded in either brand. The full source review copy is outside the served output directory.

The separately upgraded private hub is saved beside the original. It retains all original sections, refreshes shared navigation and design styles, adds a document reader for its 27 embedded documents, renders tables and bullets, and previews verified skill and blueprint files. Its scripts compile; browser file URL policy prevented visual QA. Original source hash is unchanged.

Browser checks and static file checks are recorded in shared/career-import/validation.json. The existing project/OpenAI workspace expansion remains unfinished; current work followed the user's new request to inspect and import this hub first.
